Repair Tips

Simple first aid for your phone

Practical advice from the counter — what to do in the first minutes after damage, and how to keep your battery healthy.

Start a repair enquiry →
Repair Tip

Cracked Screen? Do This First

Don’t keep tapping a cracked screen — pressure spreads the crack and glass bits can cut your finger. Cover it with clear tape or a tempered glass for now, back up your photos, and bring it in. Check first, repair after — tension lina pardaina.

Ask about screen repair →
Repair Tip

Battery Care — Make It Last Longer

Try to keep your charge between roughly 20% and 80%, avoid heavy gaming while charging, and keep the phone out of strong heat. Battery fuleko (swollen) dekhnu bho bhane, turuntai change garaunus — that one is genuinely risky.

Get your battery checked →
Repair Tip

Phone Fell in Water? First Steps

Switch it off immediately and do NOT charge it — charging a wet phone causes the real damage. Chamal (rice) ma rakhne chalan chha, but it’s no guarantee the inside dries out. Best move: phone off, and bring it to the counter as fast as you can.

Water damage help →
